name: Select
usage: Filters, enumerated form fields, choosing members and roles

props.name: options
props.description: The options, optionally in groups.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when an option is chosen, even if it was already selected (unlike `onChange`).

props.name: popupMatchSelectWidth
props.description:
`true`: the list of options is exactly as wide as the field, and long options are cut off with an ellipsis.
`false`: the list is at least as wide as the field and grows to fit its options. By default it is `false`, so
the options of a narrow field are not cut off, and `true` for more than 100 options, which keeps the list
virtualized (a list that grows to fit its options renders every option).

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the selection, inside the field, such as an icon.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Lets the user type to filter the options by their text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading indicator, such as while the options are fetched.

props.name: block
props.description:
Fills the width of the container. Inside Form.Item the field fills the width already; use it outside forms
when the field must be as wide as other inputs.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Appearance: `filled` (a borderless well in the surface, the default), `outlined` (surface background with a thin
border) or `borderless`.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.

props.name: open
props.description: The list of options is open (controlled).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The list of options is open initially.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the list of options opens or closes.

props.name: ref
props.description: Handle of the field.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.

props.name: testId
props.description:
Test id, rendered as `data-testid`: on the root element of Select, TreeSelect, Cascader and AutoComplete, on the
input of DatePicker and TimePicker, and on an element that adds no box around the two inputs of a range picker.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the input when it mounts.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input gets the focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses the focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Called on key presses in the input.

modes.title: Single selection (default)
modes.description: `value` is one value. There is no clear button, so `onChange` always receives the value of an option.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while something is selected; `onChange` then receives `null` when cleared.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows selecting several options; the value becomes an array.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the selected option (controlled); `null` keeps it empty, and `undefined` makes it uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value.

modes.title: Single selection that can be cleared: `allowClear`
modes.description:
`value` is one value; a clear button appears while something is selected, and `onChange` receives `null` when
the field is cleared.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while something is selected; `onChange` then receives `null` when cleared.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows selecting several options; the value becomes an array.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the selected option (controlled); `null` keeps it empty, and `undefined` makes it uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value; `null` when cleared.

modes.title: Multiple selection: `multiple`
modes.description:
`value` is an array; the selected options are shown as tags in the field, and `onChange` receives the array of
values in the order they were selected (an empty array when all are removed).

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while something is selected.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows selecting several options; the value becomes an array.

props.name: value
props.description: Values of the selected options (controlled); `null` keeps it empty, and `undefined` makes it uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected values (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new values.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text of the option, also shown in the field when selected.

types.name: SelectOptionGroup<V>
types.summary: A group of options of Select, with a heading.

types.name: SelectRef
types.summary: Handle of Select and TreeSelect: focus and blur.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Single selection; add `showSearch` when there are many options.

examples.name: Block
examples.title: Full width
examples.description: Add `block` outside forms when the select must be as wide as other inputs.
